about: Decisions for SimOxide's semantics when not reproducing Slingshot. choice is slingshot, fixed, other, unsure, or keep.

answers.title: Disregard does not restore adjustor state
Cooldown is committed when the request is made
answers.choice_label: Slingshot’s behavior is the right semantics
answers.note: a cooldown is a constraint on an adjustment made to the target, even though that adjustment may not effectiively change the capacity of the target group

answers.title: AVERAGE is an exponential moving average
answers.choice_label: Keep this behavior

answers.title: A relative change of 0 ignores the minimum step
answers.choice_label: The fixed behavior is the right semantics

answers.title: Scale-in drops jobs on the removed container
answers.choice_label: The fixed behavior is the right semantics
answers.note: I think also in palladio/slingshot the container drains, the resource container is deleted but the queue in the underlying data structure is cleaned up only after

answers.title: Every link is connected to every container
answers.choice_label: The fixed behavior is the right semantics

answers.title: Top-down scale-in removes empty containers one enactment late
answers.choice_label: The fixed behavior is the right semantics
answers.note:
The fix is the right top-down transformation semantic. It was not deleted to account for requests in transit.
A top-down scale-in assumes, that the effect of scaling in components automatically translates to the scaling in of hosts/containers/vms; however, that does not need to be the case. In practice, these two can be controlled independently.

answers.title: Top-down placement follows Java hash order
answers.choice_label: The fixed behavior is the right semantics
answers.note: So what is the issue if it changes between JVMs ?

answers.title: Group size is not checked before the request
answers.choice_label: Neither — the rule should be something else
answers.note: it has to make sure if the change is lt or gt, then the decision is not simply ignored while it lays out of the bounds, but the decision has to be modified to max and min. This was part of the qvto transformation and not in the filter chain in Slingshot.

answers.title: Static fields in TargetGroupUtils
answers.choice_label: The fixed behavior is the right semantics

answers.title: An unsupported trigger drops the whole SPD
answers.choice_label: The fixed behavior is the right semantics

answers.title: AND / OR / XOR triggers do not combine the children
answers.choice_label: Not sure yet
answers.note: on every event or on relevant events?
